caption:
Every washing day, Koko wrestles the fitted sheet, and her lower back twinges as she stretches across to the far corner.

Bending while reaching far and twisting can add load to the back. Walking to each corner and kneeling to tuck it in usually feels much easier.

Hybi's bed routine: walk to each corner, kneel on one knee to tuck, lift the mattress edge just a little with bent knees, and grab a helper for heavy mattresses. Stop if your leg tingles.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
